blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Army’s 33rd Infantry Battalion (IB) deployed troops, backed by armored personnel carriers, on Thursday to a village in Aleosan, North Cotabato, to pacify warring armed groups identified with the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF). ‎‎Colonel Ramel Hojilla, North Cotabato police director, said two minor siblings were killed on Tuesday after hostilities erupted between feuding Moro clans in Sitio Tubak, Barangay Pagangan. ‎Brig. Gen. Ricky Bunayog, commander of the 602nd Infantry Brigade, said initial information and accounts from residents indicated the conflict stemmed from a territorial dispute between two individuals from different groups within the MILF.
